text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Good question... I think I managed to
show them
all what I was capable of.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I keep winning at the central level, it's
only a
matter of time before people
back home start
hearing about me—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, about Oguri Cap... Y'know, the one
who just
ran? What's she like?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I heard she was really famous
around her
hometown. Personally, I
don't know much about
her though.

On the way back to the academy from
Oguri
Cap's race...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. What do you think we should do
next?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know I need to keep racing, but is that
really
enough?

She seems lost in thought. I figure she's
troubled
by the comments she overheard
from those
spectators after the race.

She's right. She may be the talk of the
academy,
but she's not exactly a
household name yet.
There's only one
way to change that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As many as I can, huh? So I just have to
run a lot?
choice_data_list: とにかく、たくさんレースに出ればいい
choice_data_list_en: Anyway, just enter as many races as you can.

text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is still relatively unknown, but
that just
means we have to show them
how powerful and
charming she really is.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: 『中央にオグリが来た』と教えてあげよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's tell them, 'Oguri's Come to the Central Circuit!'

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I gotta run until the folks back home
hear my
name!

Oguri Cap's eyes are sparkling with
ambition.
There's no doubt in my mind
that she'll do
amazingly in her upcoming
races.
